cards.title: Enable RLS
cards.description: RLS should enforce ownership in the database, not only in the interface.

cards.title: Service Keys
cards.code:
// Never expose secret or service-role keys in browser/mobile code.
// They bypass Row Level Security and belong only in trusted server environments.
cards.description: Use publishable keys in clients and least-privilege secrets on servers.

cards.title: Edge Function
cards.description: Keep edge operations short-lived and idempotent; move heavy jobs to workers.

cards.title: Security Checklist
cards.code:
enable + test RLS
use least-privilege grants
never expose service secrets
validate function authorization
test policies with multiple users
index columns used by policies
plan backups and restore tests
cards.description: A working query is not proof that its access policy is correct.
